verdict.rationale: Ramp Treasury lets the same Checking Account used for bill and card payments earn 2% APY. Reserve cash can earn up to 4.46% in an in-platform Investment Account (government money market funds and Treasuries, $5,000 minimum). The Banking API exposes both account types and their balance history, so yield sits alongside operating cash without moving money to another provider. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the yield rates and experience; the APY footnote conditions are not shown; and deposits are actually held at a partner bank (First Internet Bank of Indiana), with the Investment Account not FDIC insured.
